name: M2MMA Inc.
summary: Real American Capital Corp. operates a chain of retail stores. The company offers apparel, boots, belts, buckles, accessories, jewelry, home décor, furnishings, and antiques. It serves celebrities and VIP's from entertainment, arts, music, movies, sports, politics, and theatre. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Rancho Mirage, California.
